name: FerroBRIDGEPlToLocationWithOneChainOfLevels
title: FerroBRIDGE supplement: PL to Location with one partOf chain of levels
description: Overrides ConceptMap/datatype-pl-to-location of hl7.fhir.uv.v2mappings 1.0.0. The guide writes one Location per PL level ([1] bed, [2] room, [3] floor, [4] point of care, [5] building, [6] facility) and orders the finest level in its PL.10 rows as bed, room, point of care, floor, building, facility, but its partOf rows disagree with that order and with each other: the room is part of the floor, the floor of the point of care, the point of care of the facility, and the building of itself. This supplement links every level to the next coarser one in the PL.10 order (bed in room, room in point of care, point of care in floor, floor in building, building in facility; FHIR R4 Location.partOf), so the levels form one chain. The guide's PL.1 rows write mode and physicalType into a location(Location...) element Location does not have, and assign the physical type /extension??-poc/, which is no code; this supplement writes them at mode and physicalType of the point of care and assigns wa (Ward) from the location-physical-type code system, the code the guide repository's MDM^T02 sample Bundle gives PL.1. Its PL.10 rows name the point of care [5] and the building [4] in the first set, and carry the conditions "PL.1 VALUE" and "PL3.NOT VALUED"; this supplement names [4] and [5] as the second set does and reads VALUED and PL.3. PL.9 is written into the finest valued level under the PL.10 conditions, where the guide writes it into location(Location.description) of the bed. Every other row is the guide's. FerroBRIDGE #342; recorded as an upstream defect on FerroBRIDGE #332.
